text: Acme Widget reset procedure: hold the power button for ten seconds until the status light blinks amber, then release. The widget restarts with factory network settings.
Acme Widget battery: the 4000 mAh cell charges over USB-C and reaches a full charge in about ninety minutes. Avoid third-party fast chargers.
Acme Widget warranty covers manufacturing defects for two years from the purchase date. Accidental damage is not covered.
The Acme Widget companion app pairs over Bluetooth and requires location permission on Android. iOS pairing needs Bluetooth enabled in Settings.
